en:hiding.enDefinition: The skin of an animal. · One's own life or personal safety, especially when in peril. · (mainly British) A covered structure from which hunters, birdwatchers, etc can observe animals without scaring them. · A secret room for hiding oneself or valuables; a hideaway.

en:seemed.enDefinition: To appear; to look outwardly; to be perceived as.
en:seemed.deDefinition: (zu sein) scheinen, anscheinend sein, erscheinen · scheinen

en:breakfast.enDefinition: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning. · A meal consisting of food normally eaten in the morning, which may typically include eggs, sausages, toast, bacon, etc. · The celebratory meal served after a wedding (and occasionally after other solemnities e.g. a funeral). · A meal eaten after a period of (now often religious) fasting.

en:engine.enDefinition: A large construction used in warfare, such as a battering ram, catapult etc. · A complex mechanical device which converts energy into useful motion or physical effects. · A person or group of people which influence a larger group; a driving force. · The part of a car or other vehicle which provides the force for motion, now especially one powered by internal combustion.

en:written.enDefinition: Of, relating, or characteristic of writing (i.e., of that which has been written). · Having been written.

en:complete.enDefinition: To finish; to make done; to reach the end. · To make whole or entire. · To call from the small blind in an unraised pot. · to accomplish every significant achievement within a field

en:video.enDefinition: Transient visual content or media, processed with technology, especially electronic. · A recording or medium of visual content, especially audiovisual content for playback; a motion picture, movie, film.

en:applause.enDefinition: The act of applauding; approbation and praise publicly expressed by the clapping of hands, stamping or tapping of the feet, acclamation, huzzas, or other means; marked commendation.

en:however.definition: bununla birlikte, yine de · nasıl olursa olsun, nasıl (yapar)san (yap), neresinden (bakar)san (bak)
en:however.enDefinition: Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of that. · In contrast. · Regardless of how; no matter how · Regardless of how; regardless of the way in which.
en:however.deDefinition: trotzdem, eine Einräumung · Verstärkung des Fragewortes wie, hauptsächlich Britisch · egal, unabhängig · welcher Größe oder in welchem Ausmaß

en:pressure.enDefinition: A pressing; a force applied to a surface. · The amount of force that is applied over a given area divided by the size of this area; force per unit area. · An amount of pressure. · A contrasting force or impulse of any kind.

en:fresh.enDefinition: Newly produced or obtained; recent. · Not dried, frozen, or spoiled. · (of plant material) Still green and not dried. · Invigoratingly cool and refreshing.

en:weapon.enDefinition: An instrument of attack or defense in combat or hunting, e.g. most guns, missiles, or swords. · An instrument or other means of harming or exerting control over another. · A tool of any kind. · An idiot, an oaf, a fool, a tool; a contemptible or incompetent person.

en:sky.enDefinition: The atmosphere above a given point, especially as visible from the surface of the Earth as the place where the sun, moon, stars, and clouds are seen. · With a descriptive word: the part of the sky which can be seen from a specific place or at a specific time; its climate, condition, etc. · Ellipsis of sky blue. · The set of all lightlike lines (or directions) passing through a given point in space-time.

en:stole.enDefinition: To take illegally, or without the owner's permission, something owned by someone else without intending to return it. · To appropriate without giving credit or acknowledgement. · To get or effect surreptitiously or artfully. · To acquire at a low price.
en:stole.deDefinition: etwas heimlich an sich nehmen oder verwenden, ohne das Recht dazu zu haben: stehlen · etwas schnell oder heimlich erlangen, durch Überraschung oder einen Trick: stehlen · sich heimlich und schleichend fortbewegen, ohne das es jemand merkt: sich wegstehlen

en:study.enDefinition: To review materials already learned in order to make sure one does not forget them, usually in preparation for an examination. · To take a course or courses on a subject. · To acquire knowledge on a subject with the intention of applying it in practice. · To look at carefully and minutely.

en:treat.enDefinition: To negotiate, discuss terms, bargain (for or with). · To discourse; to handle a subject in writing or speaking; to conduct a discussion. · To discourse on; to represent or deal with in a particular way, in writing or speaking. · To handle, deal with or behave towards in a specific way.

en:roll.enDefinition: To revolve by turning over and over; to move by turning on a horizontal axis; to impel forward with a revolving motion on a supporting surface. · To wrap (something) round on itself; to form into a spherical or cylindrical body by causing to turn over and over. · To bind or involve by winding, as with a bandage; to enwrap; often with up. · To drive, impel, or flow onward with a steady, wave-like motion.

en:double.enDefinition: Made up of two matching or complementary elements. · Of twice the quantity. · Of a family relationship, related on both the maternal and paternal sides of a family. · Designed for two (people, cars, etc.).

en:spirit.enDefinition: The soul of a person or other creature. · A supernatural being, often but not exclusively without physical form; ghost, fairy, angel. · Enthusiasm. · Energy; ardour.
en:spirit.deDefinition: der Geist · die Einstellung, die Stimmung · der Elan, der Schwung · die Stimmung, die Laune

en:danger.enDefinition: Exposure to likely harm; risk of death or serious injury. · An instance or cause of likely serious harm. · The stop indication of a signal (usually in the phrase "at danger"). · A contemptible person, especially one seen as perverted or mentally ill.

en:cost.enDefinition: To incur a charge of; to require payment of a (specified) price. · To cause something to be lost; to cause the expenditure or relinquishment of. · To require to be borne or suffered; to cause. · To calculate or estimate a price.

en:empty.enDefinition: Devoid of content; containing nothing or nobody; vacant. · Containing no elements (as of a string, array, or set), opposed to being null (having no valid value). · Having nothing to carry, emptyhanded; unburdened. · Destitute of effect, sincerity, or sense; said of language.

en:level.enDefinition: The same height at all places; parallel to a flat ground. · At the same height as some reference; constructed as level with. · Unvaried in frequency. · Unvaried in volume.

en:memory.definition: bellek, dağarcık, akıl, hafıza, zihin · bellek
en:memory.enDefinition: The ability of the brain to record information or impressions with the facility of recalling them later, usually at will. · A record of a thing or an event stored and available for later use by an organism. · The part of a computer that stores variable executable code or data (RAM) or unalterable executable code or default data (ROM). · The time within which past events can be or are remembered.

en:itself.definition: (3. tekil şahıs için) kendi, kendini, kendinden. (çoğunlukla insanlar haricindeki tüm varlıklar için kullanılır) · kendisi
en:itself.enDefinition: it; A thing as the object of a verb or preposition that also appears as the subject · it; used to intensify the subject, especially to emphasize that it is the only participant in the predicate

en:acting.enDefinition: Temporarily assuming the duties or authority of another person when they are unable to do their job.

en:interest.enDefinition: great attention and concern from someone
en:interest.pairedSense: great attention and concern from someone

en:nose.enDefinition: A protuberance on the face housing the nostrils, which are used to breathe or smell. · A snout, the nose of an animal. · The tip of an object. · The bulge on the side of a piece of a jigsaw puzzle, that fits into the hole of its adjacent piece.
en:nose.deDefinition: Teil des Gesichtes, der über dem Mund liegt und zum Atmen und Riechen notwendig ist · etwas, das die Form oder die Position einer Nase hat · Fähigkeit, etwas zu riechen; Geruchssinn

en:plans.enDefinition: A drawing showing technical details of a building, machine, etc., with unwanted details omitted, and often using symbols rather than detailed drawing to represent doors, valves, etc. · A set of intended actions, usually mutually related, through which one expects to achieve a goal. · A two-dimensional drawing of a building as seen from above with obscuring or irrelevant details such as roof removed, or of a floor of a building, revealing the internal layout; as distinct from the elevation. · A method; a way of procedure; a custom.

en:following.enDefinition: Coming next, either in sequence or in time. · About to be specified. · Blowing in the direction of travel, as opposed to headwind; downwind.

en:ray.enDefinition: To emit something as if in rays. · To radiate as if in rays. · To expose to radiation.

en:band.enDefinition: A strip of material wrapped around things to hold them together. · A narrow strip of cloth or other material on clothing, to bind, strengthen, or ornament it. · A strip along the spine of a book where the pages are attached. · A belt or strap that is part of a machine.
en:band.deDefinition: Gruppe, Bande · Musikgruppe · Frequenzbereich · Band zum binden von etwas

en:groans.enDefinition: A low, mournful sound uttered in pain or grief. · A low, guttural sound uttered in frustration, disapproval, or ecstasy. · A low creaking sound from applied pressure or weight.

en:apparently.definition: görünüşe göre, görünüşe bakılacak olursa · görünüşte
en:apparently.enDefinition: Seemingly; in appearance. · According to what the speaker has read or heard. · According to what one can deduce.

en:excited.definition: heyecanlı · uyarılan, uyarılmış · uyarılmış, ereksiyon olmuş
en:excited.enDefinition: Having great enthusiasm, passion and energy. · Being in a state of higher energy. · Having an erection; erect. · Sexually aroused.

en:losing.enDefinition: cease to have in one's possession or capability
en:losing.pairedSense: cease to have in one's possession or capability

en:animals.enDefinition: A multicellular organism of the kingdom Animalia that is usually mobile, with cells that are not encased in a rigid cell wall (distinguishing them from plants and fungi) and derives energy solely from the consumption of other organisms. · Any member of the kingdom Animalia other than a human. · A higher animal; an animal related to humans. · A tetrapod; a land-dwelling nonhuman vertebrate.

en:nature.enDefinition: The way things are, the totality of all things in the physical universe and their order, especially the physical world in contrast to spiritual realms and flora and fauna as distinct from human conventions, art, and technology. · The essential or innate characteristics of a person or thing which will always tend to manifest, especially in contrast to specific contexts, reason, religious duty, upbringing, and personal pretense or effort. · The distinguishing characteristic of a person or thing, understood as its general class, sort, type, etc. · The vital functions or strength of someone or something, especially (now dialect) as requiring nourishment or careful maintenance or (medicine) as a force of regeneration without special treatment.

en:pop.enDefinition: A loud, sharp sound, as of a cork coming out of a bottle, especially when the contents are pressurized by fizziness. · An effervescent or fizzy drink, most frequently nonalcoholic; soda pop. · A bottle, can, or serving of effervescent or fizzy drink, most frequently nonalcoholic; a soda pop. · A pop shot: a quick, possibly unaimed, shot with a firearm.

en:client.enDefinition: A customer, a buyer or receiver of goods or services. · The role of a computer application or system that requests and/or consumes the services provided by another having the role of server. · A person who receives help or services from a professional such as a lawyer or accountant. · A person who employs or retains an attorney to represent him or her in any legal matter, or one who merely divulges confidential matters to an attorney while pursuing professional assistance without subsequently retaining the attorney.
en:client.deDefinition: eine Dienste eines Anwalts oder ähnliche auch soziale Dienste nutzende Person · eine im Handel kaufende Person · ein Client

en:neck.enDefinition: The part of the body connecting the head and the trunk found in humans and some animals. · The corresponding part in some other anatomical contexts. · The part of a shirt, dress etc., which fits a person's neck. · The tapered part of a bottle toward the opening.

en:suspect.enDefinition: To imagine or suppose (something) to be true, or to exist, without proof. · To distrust or have doubts about (something or someone). · To believe (someone) to be guilty. · To have suspicion.

en:warm.enDefinition: having a temperature slightly higher than usual
en:warm.pairedSense: having a temperature slightly higher than usual

en:extra.enDefinition: Beyond what is due, usual, expected, or necessary; extraneous; additional; supernumerary. · Over the top; going beyond what is normal or appropriate, often in a dramatic manner.
en:extra.deDefinition: jenseits von dem, was üblich ist oder erwartet wird, Extra-, zusätzlich, außerordentlich, außergewöhnlich

en:van.enDefinition: A covered motor vehicle used to carry goods or (normally less than ten) persons, usually roughly cuboid in shape, Depending on the type of van, it can be bigger or smaller than a pickup truck and SUV, and longer and higher than a car but relatively smaller than a truck/lorry or a bus. · An enclosed railway vehicle for transport of goods, such as a boxcar/box van. · A large towable vehicle equipped for the repair of structures that cannot easily be moved.
en:van.deDefinition: geschlossener Kraftwagen mittlerer Größe mit Fenstern rundum oder nur vorn · britisch: geschlossener Eisenbahnwagen für Gepäck oder andere Güter wie Post · militärisch oder im übertragenen Sinn vorausgehende Gruppe

en:mommy.enDefinition: Mother. · A sexually attractive mother. · Any sexually attractive woman. · A dominant female partner, often used as a term of address.

en:dogs.definition: adam, herif · köpek, it · çirkin, sevimsiz, sıkıcı kadın veya kız
en:dogs.enDefinition: The species Canis familiaris (sometimes designated Canis lupus familiaris), domesticated for thousands of years and of highly variable appearance because of human breeding. · Any member of the family Canidae, including domestic dogs, wolves, coyotes, jackals, and their relatives (extant and extinct). · A male dog, wolf, or fox, as opposed to a bitch or vixen. · A dull, unattractive girl or woman.
en:dogs.deDefinition: fleischfressendes Säugetier der Gattung Canis · männlicher Hund [1]

en:ridiculous.enDefinition: Deserving of ridicule; foolish, absurd. · Astonishing, extreme, unbelievable.

en:lee.enDefinition: A protected cove or harbor, out of the wind. · The side of the ship away from the wind. · A sheltered place, especially a place protected from the wind by some object; the side sheltered from the wind (see also leeside); shelter; protection. · Calm, peace.

en:animal.enDefinition: A multicellular organism of the kingdom Animalia that is usually mobile, with cells that are not encased in a rigid cell wall (distinguishing them from plants and fungi) and derives energy solely from the consumption of other organisms. · Any member of the kingdom Animalia other than a human. · A higher animal; an animal related to humans. · A tetrapod; a land-dwelling nonhuman vertebrate.

en:billy.enDefinition: A fellow, companion, comrade, mate; partner, brother. · A good friend. · A billy goat.
en:billy.deDefinition: der Behälter zum Gebrauch über dem Lagerfeuer · der Stock zum Gebrauch als Waffe · die männliche Ziege

en:shooting.enDefinition: Moving or growing quickly · Of a pain, sudden and darting

en:keeps.enDefinition: To continue in (a course or mode of action); to not intermit or fall from; to uphold or maintain. · To remain faithful to a given promise or word. · To maintain possession of. · To maintain the condition of; to preserve in a certain state.

en:camp.definition: kamp, düşerge · kamp yapma · homo, ibne · kadınsı
en:camp.enDefinition: An outdoor place acting as temporary accommodation in tents or other simple structures. · An organised event, often taking place in tents or temporary accommodation. · A base of a military group, not necessarily temporary. · A place of politically motivated confinement in outdoorsy conditions, usually also leading to slave labor and death.
en:camp.deDefinition: ein Platz mit behelfsmäßigen Behausungen wie Zelten oder Baracken · die Anhänger einer Anschauung in Gegensatz zu jenen anderer Anschauung

en:guns.enDefinition: A device for shooting projectiles or ditto (a shooter), functioning through stored energy: a firearm, cannon, harpoon gun/spear gun, raygun, etc, not a bow and arrow, or slingshot. · A very portable, short firearm, for hand use, which fires bullets or projectiles, such as a handgun, revolver, pistol, or Derringer. · A less portable, long firearm that fires bullets or projectiles; a rifle, either manual, automatic or semi-automatic; a flintlock, musket or shotgun. · A cannon with relatively long barrel, operating with relatively low angle of fire, and having a high muzzle velocity.
en:guns.deDefinition: Feuerwaffe, Schusswaffe · nur Einzahl: Startsignal für ein Rennen · Pistole, Spritze (ein Werkzeug, welches eine Substanz injiziert) · eine Person, die eine Sportwaffe als Mitglied einer Gruppe benutzt

en:medical.enDefinition: Of or pertaining to the practice of medicine. · Intended to have a therapeutic effect; medicinal. · Requiring medical treatment. · Pertaining to the state of one's health.

en:shame.enDefinition: An uncomfortable or painful feeling due to recognition or consciousness of one's own impropriety or dishonor, or something being exposed that should have been kept private. · Something to regret. · Reproach incurred or suffered; dishonour; ignominy; derision. · The cause or reason of shame; that which brings reproach and ignominy.

en:hoping.enDefinition: To want (something) to happen, with a sense of expectation that it might [with that (+ clause); or (informal) with clause; or with so or (negative) not]. · To intend to do something and look forward to the prospect of having done it [with to (+ infinitive)]. · To expect optimistically that one might get something (either a change in circumstance or an object) [with for]. · To place confidence; to trust with confident expectation of good [with in].

en:whom.enDefinition: what person; object of a verb (accusative)
en:whom.pairedSense: what person; object of a verb (accusative)

en:majesty.enDefinition: The quality of being impressive, great, dignified, powerful, sovereign, or any combination thereof.

en:flowers.enDefinition: A colorful, conspicuous structure associated with angiosperms, frequently scented and attracting various insects, and which may or may not be used for sexual reproduction. · A reproductive structure in angiosperms (flowering plants), often conspicuously colourful and typically including sepals, petals, and either or both stamens and/or a pistil. · A plant that bears flowers, especially a plant that is small and lacks wood. · The stem of a flowering plant with the blossom or blossoms attached, used for decoration, as a gift, etc.

en:famous.enDefinition: Well known. · In the public eye. · Excellent.

en:asleep.enDefinition: In a state of sleep; also, broadly, resting. · Inattentive. · Having a numb or prickling sensation accompanied by a degree of unresponsiveness. · Dead.

en:beauty.definition: güzellik · güzel kadın veya kız · afet
en:beauty.enDefinition: The quality of being (especially visually) attractive, pleasing, fine or good-looking; comeliness. · Someone who is beautiful. · Those aspects or elements that make someone or something beautiful. · Something that is particularly good or pleasing.

en:driver.enDefinition: person who drives some other vehicle
en:driver.pairedSense: person who drives some other vehicle

en:keys.definition: biçem düzlemi · anahtar, açar, açkı · davranca · tuş
en:keys.deDefinition: Schlüssel · Chiffrierschlüssel, Chiffre, Kennzahl, Passwort · Taste · flache Insel (aus Korallen)

en:rain.enDefinition: Condensed water falling from a cloud. · Any matter moving or falling, usually through air, and especially if liquid or otherwise figuratively identifiable with raindrops. · An instance of particles or larger pieces of matter moving or falling through air.

en:awful.definition: oldukça büyük, korkunç, müthiş, berbat, çok kötü
en:awful.enDefinition: Very bad. · Exceedingly great; usually applied intensively. · Prone to a particular temptation.

en:large.enDefinition: Of considerable or relatively great size or extent. · That is large (the manufactured size). · Crossing the line of a ship's course in a favorable direction; said of the wind when it is abeam, or between the beam and the quarter.

en:local.enDefinition: From or in a nearby location. · Connected directly to a particular computer, processor, etc.; able to be accessed offline. · Having limited scope (either lexical or dynamic); only accessible within a certain portion of a program. · Satisfied by at least one open neighborhood of every point.

en:deserve.enDefinition: To be entitled to, as a result of past actions; to be worthy to have.

en:goddamn.enDefinition: An expression of anger, surprise, intense excitement or frustration.

en:stone.enDefinition: A hard earthen substance that can form rocks; especially, such substance when regarded as a building material. · A piece of such material: a block of stone, rock or a pebble. · A gemstone, a jewel, especially a diamond. · A unit of weight equal to 14 pounds (≈6.3503 kilograms), formerly used for various commodities (wool, cheese, etc.), but now principally used for personal weight. Abbreviated as st.

en:grace.enDefinition: Charming, pleasing qualities. · A short prayer of thanks before or after a meal. · In the games of patience or solitaire: a special move that is normally against the rules. · A grace note.

en:consider.definition: addetmek, dikkate almak · itibar etmek, saygı göstermek · sanmak · düşünüp taşınmak
en:consider.enDefinition: To think about seriously. · To think about something seriously or carefully: to deliberate. · To think about whether one will do (an action); to weigh as a possible course of action. · To assign some quality to.

en:weekend.enDefinition: The break in the working week, usually two days including the traditional holy or sabbath day. Thus in Western countries, Saturday and Sunday.

en:wondering.enDefinition: something that causes amazement or awe, a marvel
en:wondering.pairedSense: something that causes amazement or awe, a marvel

en:lay.enDefinition: To place down in a position of rest, or in a horizontal position. · To compel a supernatural entity to cease haunting a place, often by ritual or prayer; to exorcise or banish (a spirit or ghost). · To prepare (a plan, project etc.); to set out, establish (a law, principle). · To install certain building materials, laying one thing on top of another.

en:plenty.enDefinition: A more-than-adequate amount; plenitude; a great deal.

en:willing.enDefinition: Ready to do something, particularly something that requires change or effort; not objecting.

en:pants.definition: (BK ağzı) erkek veya kadın külotu. · (ABD ağzı) pantolon. · (BK ağzı) işe yaramaz şey, saçmalık.
en:pants.enDefinition: An outer garment that covers the body from the waist downwards, covering each leg separately, usually as far as the ankles; trousers. · An undergarment that covers the genitals and often the buttocks and the neighbouring parts of the body; underpants. · Rubbish; something worthless.

en:sweetheart.enDefinition: A person who is always very kind. · A person very much liked or loved by someone, especially when both partners are young. · A term of endearment, especially for a lover or child. · A female member of a college or university fraternity.
en:sweetheart.deDefinition: Liebling, Schatz · abschätzig gegenüber eine Frau, deren Name nicht bekannt ist. Liebchen, Häschen

en:skin.enDefinition: outer protective layer of the body of a person or animal
en:skin.pairedSense: outer protective layer of the body of a person or animal

en:excellent.enDefinition: Having excelled, having surpassed. · Of higher or the highest quality; splendid. · Exceptionally good of its kind. · Superior in kind or degree, irrespective of moral quality.
